passwords.title: Passwords
passwords.description: The team's and each client's passwords, encrypted end to end: they open with your master password, and neither the server nor anyone looking at the database can read them.
passwords.search: Search by name, username or site…
passwords.autoLocked: The vault locked itself after {minutes} minutes unused.

setup.title: Your master password
setup.descriptionFirst: You are about to create the team vault. Your master password never leaves this browser: everything else is encrypted with it.
setup.descriptionJoin: Create your master password. A partner who already has access will then hand you the vault key.
setup.masterHint: At least 12 characters. Not one of the passwords you are going to store in it.
setup.mismatch: Does not match the one above.
setup.warning: Write it down somewhere safe: we store it nowhere and it cannot be recovered. If you lose it, someone has to grant you access again and anything you cannot open must be changed.
setup.createdVault: Vault created: you can start saving passwords.
setup.createdKeys: Done: ask a partner to grant you access.

waiting.title: You still need access
waiting.description: Your master password is ready. Someone with access now has to hand you the vault key.
waiting.noHolders: Nobody has access to the vault yet.

unlock.title: Open the vault
unlock.description: Type your master password. It stays in this browser and the vault locks itself after a while unused.
unlock.wrong: That is not your master password.
unlock.failed: The vault could not be opened.

sheet.description: Everything you type here is encrypted before it leaves the browser.
sheet.name: Name
sheet.totpHint: The string behind the QR code when you turn on two-step verification, in case it has to be recovered.
sheet.archiveConfirm: It disappears from the list. Who archived it and when stays in the audit log.

access.title: Who can open the vault
access.description: Granting access prepares a copy of the key for that person, encrypted with their key. Your master password is never shared.
access.revokeConfirm: They will no longer be able to open the vault. Whatever they already saw, they saw: change those passwords.
access.note: Anyone who has not created their master password yet does not appear here.

errors.notFound: That password no longer exists or you have no access.
errors.alreadyExists: The vault already exists: ask a partner to grant you access.
